assembly.scope: Closed finite CandidatePairsChecked theorem: for every one of the 21 first canonical directions and 21 second canonical multisets, every signed second vector with positive initial coordinate and the required absolute multiset permutation satisfies productCheck whenever all RepeatTests hold. The recursive certificate soundness theorem covers all 1,137,991,680 pairs; the numerical table uses 760 bounded kernel checks and 52 proved joins. This does not by itself prove the real eight-plane classification, its normalization hypotheses, or the complete eight-speed spectrum.

pattern-0.scope: All 21 checked prefix certificates for first canonical pattern 0, one for each second canonical multiset. Each covers 2,580,480 signed coordinate vectors with positive initial coordinate. Generic cut soundness, recursive permutation coverage, and composition theorems are independently checked in every group. Other first patterns and the closed finite theorem are separate jobs; no mathematical plane classification is claimed.
